cards.title: Introduction to C# in ASP.NET Core
cards.content: C# is a modern, object-oriented, and strongly typed programming language developed by Microsoft. It is the primary language used for building robust web applications and APIs with ASP.NET Core.

cards.title: Key Features of C#
cards.content:
ASP.NET Core leverages several advanced C# features:

  • Automatic Garbage Collection
  • Language Integrated Query (LINQ)
  • Asynchronous Programming with async and await
  • Nullable Reference Types

options.text: C# is purely a functional programming language.
C# is a fully object-oriented language supporting encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.
C# only supports single-file procedural scripts.

cards.title: LINQ in C#
cards.content:
Language Integrated Query (LINQ) provides a consistent query syntax for querying data from collections, databases, and XML. Example:

var results = from user in users
              where user.Age > 18
              select user;

cards.title: Asynchronous Programming
cards.content: To perform non-blocking operations in C# and ASP.NET Core controllers, methods are typically marked with the async keyword and return a Task object.

cards.title: Conclusion and Next Steps
cards.content: Mastering C# syntax, object-oriented principles, and asynchronous patterns is essential for building scalable web apps with ASP.NET Core. You are now ready to build your first MVC or Web API project!
